title: Art Taste Deck
request: Max Oct 19 2026 10:58 PM ICT: 'show me a swipe deck with art. lets start to figure out what kind of art i like.'
results_tags: each option carries tags [style, era, mood]; results carry artA / artB with the same fields

pairs.ask: Bold drama or quiet rain?

optionA.label: The Great Wave off Kanagawa
optionA.desc: A colour woodblock print: a clawed wave towers over boats, with Mount Fuji tiny behind.

optionB.label: Sudden Shower over Shin-Ōhashi Bridge
optionB.desc: A woodblock print of fine slanting rain over a bridge, people hurrying under hats.

pairs.ask: Real gold shine, or soft window light?

optionA.label: The Kiss
optionA.desc: Two lovers wrapped in a robe of real gold leaf, on a shimmering gold ground.

optionB.label: The Milkmaid
optionB.desc: A kitchen maid pours milk in soft window light; the bread almost glitters.

pairs.ask: Warm tropical oil, or a breezy island watercolour?

optionA.label: Tahitian Landscape
optionA.desc: Tahiti in warm flat colour: orange earth, deep greens, a figure resting under the trees.

optionB.label: Palm Tree, Nassau
optionB.desc: A quick watercolour of a palm bending in island wind over turquoise water.

pairs.ask: Gold glowing in shadow, or humble and rough?

optionA.label: Writing Box with Birdcage
optionA.desc: A lacquer writing box with a birdcage in gold maki-e: gold that glows best in low light.

optionB.label: Black Raku Tea Bowl
optionB.desc: A hand-shaped black tea bowl, rough and humble: the heart of wabi-sabi.

pairs.ask: Flat colour pattern, or machine-age graphic?

optionA.label: Harmony in Red (The Dessert)
optionA.desc: A room flooded with red, its blue vines running from tablecloth to wall.

optionB.label: The Typographer
optionB.desc: A machine-age figure built from bold tubes, blocks and primary colours.

pairs.ask: Gentle ink and gold, or bright five-colour enamel?

optionA.label: The Cat Treatise (Tamra Maeo)
optionA.desc: A Thai folding book of lucky cat breeds, painted in soft ink, pink and gold.

optionB.label: Benjarong Lidded Bowl
optionB.desc: Thai five-colour enamel porcelain, dense with flowers and gold.

pairs.ask: Lantern glow at dusk, or fireworks at night?

optionA.label: Carnation, Lily, Lily, Rose
optionA.desc: Two girls light paper lanterns among lilies at dusk; the glow is the subject.

optionB.label: Nocturne in Black and Gold: The Falling Rocket
optionB.desc: Fireworks drifting down through a dark night; almost abstract.

pairs.ask: A calm sea horizon, or mountain grandeur?

optionA.label: The Great Wave, Sète
optionA.desc: An early photograph of a calm sea and huge sky, a quiet horizon line.

optionB.label: The Tetons and the Snake River
optionB.desc: Black and white grandeur: a river curving toward sharp mountains.

pairs.ask: Calm flat gold, or electric detail?

optionA.label: Irises at Yatsuhashi
optionA.desc: Folding screens of blue irises and a zigzag bridge on flat gold: the root of superflat.

optionB.label: Rooster and Sunflowers
optionB.desc: A rooster in electric detail under sunflowers, from the Colorful Realm of Living Beings.

pairs.ask: A sunlit empty room, or a lighthouse in hard sun?

optionA.label: Interior in Strandgade, Sunlight on the Floor
optionA.desc: An empty grey room where a patch of sunlight on the floor is the whole story.

optionB.label: The Lighthouse at Two Lights
optionB.desc: A white lighthouse in hard clean sun, still and a little lonely.

pairs.ask: A dream jungle, or a real tropical view?

optionA.label: Tropical Forest with Monkeys
optionA.desc: A dream jungle: layered leaves, playful monkeys, painted by a man who never left France.

optionB.label: View over Ocho Rios, Jamaica
optionB.desc: A travelling botanist's sunlit view of green hills, palms and sea.

pairs.ask: Crisp grid, or soft organic shapes?

optionA.label: Composition II in Red, Blue and Yellow
optionA.desc: Black lines and three primary blocks on white: order at its simplest.

optionB.label: The Ten Largest, No. 5, Adulthood
optionB.desc: A huge soft-pink abstraction of blooms and spirals, years before abstract art had a name.

pairs.ask: Impressionist haze, or a glowing modern print?

optionA.label: Water Lilies
optionA.desc: Lilies floating in a pond that melts into sky reflections.

optionB.label: Kumoi Cherry Trees
optionB.desc: A modern woodblock of cherry trees glowing in soft spring light.

pairs.ask: An old print full of puns, or a playful street mural?

optionA.label: Cats Suggested as the Fifty-three Stations of the Tōkaidō
optionA.desc: Dozens of cats acting out place-name puns: a joke in every corner.

optionB.label: Little Children on a Bicycle
optionB.desc: A street mural in Penang with a real bicycle bolted on: a wink in public.

pairs.ask: Ink mist and emptiness, or golden colour haze?

optionA.label: Pine Trees
optionA.desc: Ink pines dissolving into mist across a pair of folding screens: mostly emptiness.

optionB.label: Norham Castle, Sunrise
optionB.desc: A castle melting into golden haze; colour fields decades before Rothko.

pairs.ask: Calm dots, or swirling brushwork?

optionA.label: A Sunday on La Grande Jatte
optionA.desc: A sunny riverside afternoon built entirely from tiny dots of colour.

optionB.label: Wheat Field with Cypresses
optionB.desc: Swirling clouds, rolling wheat and a flame-like cypress, all in motion.

pairs.ask: One bloom up close, or a lavish dark bouquet?

optionA.label: Black Iris
optionA.desc: A single iris magnified until it fills the canvas.

optionB.label: Still Life with Flowers in a Glass Vase
optionB.desc: A lavish bouquet glowing out of a dark background.

pairs.ask: Sunlit splash, or a tender quiet moment?

optionA.label: Strolling along the Seashore
optionA.desc: Two women in white walking a bright beach, veils lifting in the sea breeze.

optionB.label: The Child's Bath
optionB.desc: A mother washing a child's feet, seen from above in soft patterned colour.

pairs.ask: Flowing Art Nouveau, or a repeating garden print?

optionA.label: The Seasons
optionA.desc: Four women as the seasons, framed in flowing Art Nouveau curves.

optionB.label: Strawberry Thief
optionB.desc: Birds stealing strawberries in a repeating indigo garden pattern.

pairs.ask: Dolphins in a blue sea, or a painted garden room?

optionA.label: Dolphin Fresco
optionA.desc: Blue dolphins and little fish on a palace wall at Knossos, Crete.

optionB.label: Garden Room, Villa of Livia
optionB.desc: A whole room painted as an endless garden of fruit trees and birds.
